tradition_note: north_indian_ashtakoota (Guna Milan / Ashtakoota) is the ASSUMED default per DEC-009. It is NOT yet founder- or domain-confirmed. Confirm the intended school/authority (e.g. B. V. Raman tables per OQ-1) and whether any South-Indian Dashakoota variant is wanted before this pack is frozen.
review_notes: DRAFT rule pack. Encodes widely-documented CLASSICAL Ashtakoota tables using best-known standard values. Not yet verified against a single named textual authority.
Per DEC-009 this pack cannot back a user-facing report until a Vedic-astrology domain expert signs off and sources.json is completed (verified:true).
Per DEC-009a directional (bride/groom) role mapping (seeker/partner -> bride/groom) is a rule-pack + product decision still requiring domain review (OQ-2).

The Yoni compatibility matrix diagonal (same=4) and mortal-enemy pairs (=0) are the load-bearing certain values; intermediate friendly(3)/neutral(2)/unfriendly(1) gradations are set to a documented neutral default and MUST be verified against the cited source.
The Vashya group-score matrix and the exact Gana directional off-diagonals are the most source-variable tables; verify before freeze.
Graha Maitri encodes the full 6-outcome compound-relationship table (includes neutral-neutral=3); some schools collapse this — verify.
immutability: Frozen packs are never edited in place. Any change to any table or scoring rule requires a NEW versioned directory (e.g. ashtakoota_lahiri_classical_v2). See README.md.

directional._comment: Per-component bride/groom ordering flags. true = the computation is asymmetric in the seeker/partner (bride/groom) roles and MUST be evaluated in the mapped classical order. false = symmetric (order does not change the score).

role_mapping._comment: Neutral product roles mapped to classical directional roles per DEC-009a. This default mapping REQUIRES founder + domain confirmation (OQ-2).
